_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Sir Theodore Martin (1816-1909). Schiller's Wilhelm Tell (1847). PD. Added 2026-10-03 by lane C (round 8) under the coordinator's standing instruction; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Hertz's King René's Daughter (Orr, 1850). His Vita Nuova held (no year printed); Madonna Pia (1894) left off, as it mixes his own play with translations.

_excluded.book-of-ballads: The Book of Ballads (PG 44798, with Aytoun): parodies, not translations.
_excluded.pg-2782: Wilhelm Tell again: another Gutenberg file of Martin's translation, already held as 6788.

The Bohn Wallenstein and Wilhelm Tell (1891) adds only Coleridge's and Churchill's Wallenstein to the Tell already here.

_name_words_note: Translator name(s) only: fetch_shelf.py treats these as the identity check (one must appear in the fetched text), so the original author's name is deliberately NOT listed.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
